events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture, began in Bethel, New York on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and incredible music that defined a generation.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: 49 years since we lost The King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll through the decades.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, following a shooting in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur. His words and music continue to resonate, 30 years on from his passing.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: 56 years since the world lost a true guitar visionary. Jimi Hendrix's revolutionary sound lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles crossed that famous zebra crossing. 'Abbey Road' remains an absolute masterpiece.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and still as cool as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Parklife & Beyond
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK release anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: A Message of Peace
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' single touched hearts across the UK. Its message of peace is as powerful today as ever.

events.title: Apple's original iPod anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? 25 years since Apple changed how we listen to music forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in London in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 64 years of 007's iconic adventures.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine All The People
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental classic that still sparks debate.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly immortal.
